verdict.rationale: Apify provides an official MCP server enabling AI agents/LLMs to discover and invoke Actors via natural-language-driven agent workflows, which is the primary path to natural-language operation for AI-native users; however this relies on an external agent/LLM interpreting commands rather than Apify itself exposing a native NL interface, and there's no evidence of built-in NL command parsing in the CLI/API/console. missing for 10: first-party evidence of a native natural-language command interface (e.g., chat-based console) and independent/hands-on confirmation of MCP-driven natural-language workflows.
